**Finding submitted: MISSING (critical) — no indemnity anywhere in the Agreement.**

- **Investigation:** Searches for "indemnif", "hold harmless" and "infringe" returned nothing. Section 9 (Warranties) contains only corporate-authority reps plus the Globix carve-out; Section 10 is boilerplate (notices, no joint venture, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement).
- **Direction check:** HDI is the vendor here — it designs, develops, hosts, operates and maintains the Site on its own server and supplies the software (Sections 1.1–1.4). The IP exposure on the Site therefore sits with HDI, but nothing shifts it to them.
- **Classification:** No vendor IP indemnity at all is expressly walk-away under the rule, so this fails both preferred and fallback.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** New Section 9(c) inserted after p0058 giving the Company a defend/indemnify/hold-harmless from HDI for (1) IP infringement by the Site or HDI-provided services/software/materials (excluding our Content), (2) HDI's breach of law, (3) unauthorised access to our data/Confidential Information caused by HDI, and (4) HDI's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with notice/control/cooperation mechanics and a no-adverse-settlement proviso. Placing it in Section 9 means it survives under Section 10.7. No reciprocal Company indemnity exists, so none needed narrowing.
